summary: Libity (formerly Investcorp AI Acquisition Corp.), a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting shareholder approval of a name change and an extension of its business-combination deadline from May 12, 2027 to May 12, 2028, at an extraordinary general meeting. 99.6% of outstanding voting shares supported both proposals. The filing is a routine SPAC administrative update with no new combination announcement.
